path.description: The path to create the init.

gatewayConfig.description: Create a gateway (HTTP/WebSocket) configuration. Prompted interactively when omitted; defaults to false (a plain microservice) in non-interactive runs.

features.description: Features to include. Gateway (gatewayConfig=true): acl, gateway-admin, route-reception. Microservice (gatewayConfig=false): auto-config-publish. Prompted interactively when omitted.

exchange.description: Main AMQP exchange backing the ACL / gateway-admin queues. Default: rlb.

aclQueue.description: Queue backing the (fixed) rlb-acl topic. Default: rlb-acl.

adminQueue.description: Queue backing the (fixed) rlb-gateway-admin topic. Default: rlb-gateway-admin.

controlTopic.description: Broadcast control/reload topic name. Default: rlb-gateway-control.

routeExchange.description: Route auto-discovery fanout exchange (must match between publisher and gateway). Default: rlb-route-discovery.

routeQueue.description: Route-sync durable queue (gateway consumer side). Default: rlb-route-sync.

serviceName.description: Service name used for route auto-publish (route ownership + AMQP connection_name). Default: the project name.

skills.description: Copy the Claude skill files into .claude/skills. Prompted when omitted; defaults to true.
